game_title: Type Cast Forge – Charred Forest Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Charred Forest'. region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The smelter reached with actions_used <= 20.
